ATTAttendanceRecord Employee clock in/out with camera verification, and Overtime.Attendance with Clock In / Clock Out, photo and GPS, Arrival Status → Executive attendance with location verified; the 08:15 Late rule, Missed Clock-out at 23:59, Overtime with Pending / Approved / Rejected, Sales Supervisor approval and 48-hour escalation set up as extra fields, statuses and approval steps; Employee side from Employee Directory; offline sync as platform mechanics; second App attendance-and-leave for the sheetsFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration

INVInventorySupervisors assign product inventory to Sales Agents, who sell from it; unsold stock comes back and is counted; depot stock is read from SAP.Sales Agent Inventory → Executive stock (assigned, sold, left) with Sales Supervisor assigning; Assign Inventory with quantity and Total Amount, Stock Return with Pending and Accepted and counted quantity set up as extra fields and statuses; orders and cancels deducting from Executive stock as the App does for sales and returns; Depot stock → Warehouse/depot stock shown read only, fed from SAP by the plugin (SAP-04, not Standard); Stock in hand is not one of the App's named reports, so set up as a report with filters and Excel export; offline capture as platform mechanicsFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration

Invoice (number INV-<agent code>-<seq>, VAT, PDF on WhatsApp, Bluetooth print) is not in any App, so a Custom module (VB-09); invoice push to SAP is the plugin, an ERP link never Standard (VB-06, SAP-05)FMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
LEADLeadsSales Agents generate Leads for new business and follow them up until they become Customers or are lost.Lead → Lead; shop name, owner name, phone, address, GEO, Category and notes set up as fields; Status New, Contacted, Interested, Converted, Lost → funnel stages with Interested and Lost added; Sales Agent → Executive owning the Lead; Convert raising a Change Request approved by the Sales Supervisor → conversion approval step, with the new Customer going to CRM and to SAP through Masters and SAP Integration; Lead Sheet/Report with converted-per-month count → Lead performance report with filters and Excel export; offline capture as platform mechanicsLead ManagementConfiguration
MKTMarketing VisitsRecord marketing, school, farm and door to door visits by sales or marketing staff, for product sampling and brand awareness.Marketing Visit and Rider visit → Outlet visit and Rider visit/route with GPS tag, Beat and photo; Visit type values (School, Farm, Door to door, Shop activation), the School, Farm and Door to door forms and the typed new-person fields set up as extra fields and forms; existing Customer pick → CRM account link; Marketing Visit Sheet and Marketing Visits report (visits per rider) are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; offline capture as the App doesFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
MTModern TradeDaily modern trade updates per Store: shelf photos, stock count, competitor activities and Sales Supervisor review, giving Closing Stock Inventory.Modern Trade update and Store → Outlet visit with GPS tag, shelf photo and stock check, on a Customer flagged Modern Trade (an Outlet); Check In / Check Out within 200 m as GPS-verified visit; stock count grid (Shelf, Backroom, Expiry, Total Qty), competitor activities (Competitor Master brand and product) and Submitted / Sent back / Approved review set up as extra fields, forms and an approval step (the App says modern trade uses different forms and approvals); Modern Trade Sheet and Closing Stock Inventory are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; offline capture as the App doesFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
CMPCustomer ComplaintsSales Agents register customer product quality complaints; the Quality Manager resolves them and the customer is told.Customer Complaint → Quality complaint (description, batch number, photo, assigned QA team, status Open → closure), logged by the Sales Agent with offline capture as the App does; the four statuses Open / Under Investigation / Resolved / Closed, Operator, Shift, resolution note and customer signature set up as extra fields and statuses for the Quality Manager; 72 hour target and Complaints aging report and Complaint Sheet are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; WhatsApp message to the customer on Resolved through the platform WhatsApp channelFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
FBFeedbackA Sales Agent records customer feedback as question and response pairs.Feedback and Feedback answer (question, 1 to 5 rating, comment) have no entity in the field sales App; built as a new record type on the App's Outlet visit mechanics with offline capture; the Owner's fixed question list is a new master; Feedback Sheet with average rating per question is set up as a report with filters and Excel export; Configuration or Custom module is torn, higher proposed, OI-83FMCG Field Sales & DistributionCustom

No new record type, so no Custom module.FMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
COMCommunicationReach users and customers through WhatsApp, push notifications, Area notices and a Notice Board.Notice and Notice Board → Post in an Announcements Category with access scope (everyone / department / team) set up as All / Area / role, no pre-publication approval, poster edits or removes; Area is added as an audience field; push to the audience and the push events (leave decision, order cancelled, Change Request decision, target set) set up as notifications on the platform; WhatsApp Message → invoice PDF and Resolved message, retry 3 times and Failed status set up on the platform WhatsApp channel; the App is a forum, so the Notice fields and WhatsApp Message record are added fieldsInternal Community ForumConfiguration
AIAI FeaturesAI help: form filling through NLP, AI based planogram suggestions, and Ask Neome.Voice entry in English and Nyanja filling the Visit Book order and Complaint form, and Planogram suggestion from a Modern Trade shelf photo → no App page models either; built by Neomenta on the platform; Ask Neome → platform Conversational AI and Contextual Search & Answers over the data the user may see, set up as Configuration; the catalog does not say voice, Nyanja or image analysis are supported (catalog section 5 item 15)No catalog App (custom)Custom
SAPSAP IntegrationKeep neome and SAP in step for customers, products, employees, prices, stock and invoices, through a plugin the Neome team writes.Customers, products, employees, price lists, credit limits and open balances → Outlet, Warehouse/depot stock and Customer ledger of the field sales App, filled from SAP; plugin built by the Neome team on the SAP Business One Service Layer; Sync setting, Sync record (Sync status Waiting to sync / Synced / Failed) and Sync log added as a new record type; dashboard set-up for frequency; ERP links are never Standard and the App page names no ERP/DMS integration (catalog 4b rule 5, section 5 gap 6); Scope tag Neome as the Neome team builds the plugin. Rests on OI-08, OI-11 (closed)FMCG Field Sales & DistributionCustom

Module · MST

Masters

Keep the base lists (employees, customers, products, beats, routes, stores, categories, competitors) that orders, visits, inventory and reports use.

Neome App

FMCG Field Sales & Distribution

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Customer → Outlet, Beat and Route → Beat / route, Product → product catalog and price list, Employee → Executive; Store, Category and Competitor added as master lists with set-up fields; Customer GEO tag via GPS tag; vertical App configured to 260 Brands' route to market, Employee Directory as second App for employee data; SAP sync rules are defined in the SAP Integration spec.

Status flow

No statuses yet.

MST-01
Employee Master
The system keeps an Employee Master with contact details, assigned Beats (multi select) and Casual, Sick and Total Leave Balance. Owner adds and edits Employees; they may also come from SAP.
Acceptance criteria
  • Owner adds an employee, picks one or more Beats, and Total Leave Balance shows Casual + Sick.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-22 OI-75
MST-02
Customer Master
The system keeps a Customer Master with the fields in RFP-1 §5.2, Category and Classification values, conditional TPIN, and Route filled from the chosen Beat. Owner maintains it; Sales Agents may add Customers through a Change Request.
Acceptance criteria
  • Owner adds a customer, picks a Beat, and the Route of that Beat fills in.
  • TPIN is a 10-digit ZRA Taxpayer ID, required for Wholesaler and Supermarket, optional for other categories.
  • A Sales Agent's new Customer reaches SAP only after Sales Supervisor approval of its Change Request.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-14 OI-15 OI-16 OI-17 OI-75
MST-03
Customer GEO Tagging
Each Customer's location is captured by the Sales Agent on the first visit; only a Sales Supervisor may change it.
Acceptance criteria
  • A customer record shows its map location after tagging.
  • A Sales Agent cannot change a captured location; a Sales Supervisor can.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, IN-1, QA-1OI-21 OI-75
MST-04
Product Master
The system keeps a Product Master with Image, Product Code, Product, Case Size, Category (from Category Master) and Price.
Acceptance criteria
  • Owner adds a product with a Category from the Category Master and it can be picked in orders.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-18 OI-75
MST-05
Beat and Route Masters
The system keeps a Route Master and a Beat Master, each Beat linked to one Route; master records use Active/Inactive status and are not deleted.
Acceptance criteria
  • Owner adds a Route, then a Beat on that Route; the Beat shows its Route.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-75
MST-06
Store Master
The system keeps a Store Master of modern trade stores with store name, store supervisor, email, supervisor mobile number, area name and location.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Store added to the Store Master can be picked in Modern Trade.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-20 OI-75
MST-07
Category Master
The system keeps a Category Master used to categorise products and competitor products.
Acceptance criteria
  • Categories added appear as choices in Product Master and Competitor Master.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-75
MST-08
Competitor Master
The system keeps a Competitor Master: competitor name and its products (image, product code, product, case size, category).
Acceptance criteria
  • A competitor with products can be picked in Modern Trade competitor activities.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-19 OI-75

No Requirements match.

Module · BEAT

Beat Planning

Sales Supervisor assigns Beats to employees so they visit and order only from their Beat's customers.

Neome App

FMCG Field Sales & Distribution

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Beat → Beat / route; Employee - Beat Mapping and Weekly Beat Plan → daily beat assignment per executive, set up with one-agent-per-Beat check and Active / Inactive Beat status; Sales Agent customer pick limited to mapped Beats, offline sync as platform mechanics; Employee Directory holds the Employee side

Status flow
BEAT-01
Assign Beats to employees
A Sales Supervisor assigns one or more Beats to an employee, making the Employee - Beat Mapping, with no approval.
Acceptance criteria
  • After the Supervisor assigns Beat A to an agent, Beat A shows in that agent's mapping at once.
  • A Tricycle Rider can be mapped to Beats the same way.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-1OI-23
BEAT-02
Customers limited to assigned Beat
When placing an order, a Sales Agent selects a customer only from the Beats mapped to them, today's planned Beat first.
Acceptance criteria
  • An agent mapped only to Beat A sees only Beat A customers when placing an order.
  • An agent with no Beat mapped cannot pick a customer.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-1
BEAT-03
Weekly Beat Plan
A Sales Supervisor sets which Beat each employee works on each weekday, Monday to Saturday.
Acceptance criteria
  • Supervisor plans Beat A for an agent on Monday and Beat B on Tuesday; the agent sees Beat A as today's Beat on Monday.
  • A Beat that is not mapped to the agent cannot be put in the agent's plan.
MustNeomeWS-1OI-23
BEAT-04
One Beat, one Sales Agent
A Beat is mapped to only one Sales Agent at a time; a Sales Agent may have many Beats.
Acceptance criteria
  • Mapping Beat A to a second Sales Agent while a first holds it is refused.
  • After the first agent is unmapped, Beat A can be mapped to the second.
  • A Tricycle Rider can be mapped to a Beat that has a Sales Agent.
MustNeomeWS-1OI-24
BEAT-05
Inactive Beat
When the Owner makes a Beat inactive, its employees are unmapped and its customers stay on it for the Sales Supervisor to move.
Acceptance criteria
  • After the Owner makes Beat A inactive, no employee is mapped to Beat A and its customers still show Beat A.
  • Supervisor moves those customers to another Beat.
ShouldNeomeWS-1, QA-1OI-72
BEAT-06
Beat plan offline
A Sales Agent sees their Employee - Beat Mapping and today's Beat with no network.
Acceptance criteria
  • With the phone offline, the agent opens today's Beat and its customers.
ShouldNeomeWS-1
BEAT-07
Beat plan list
Supervisors and managers see a list of Employee - Beat Mapping and Weekly Beat Plan, filtered by supervisor, agent or beat.
Acceptance criteria
  • Supervisor filters the list by agent and sees that agent's Beats and weekday plan.
ShouldNeomeWS-1

No Requirements match.

Module · ATT

Attendance

Record Employee clock in/out with camera verification, and Overtime.

Neome App

FMCG Field Sales & Distribution

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Attendance with Clock In / Clock Out, photo and GPS, Arrival Status → Executive attendance with location verified; the 08:15 Late rule, Missed Clock-out at 23:59, Overtime with Pending / Approved / Rejected, Sales Supervisor approval and 48-hour escalation set up as extra fields, statuses and approval steps; Employee side from Employee Directory; offline sync as platform mechanics; second App attendance-and-leave for the sheets

Status flow
ATT-01
Clock in and out with photo and GPS
An Employee clocks in and out, and a selfie photo and GPS location are taken at each; no face match.
Acceptance criteria
  • Clock in cannot be saved without a photo and a GPS location.
  • Clock out saves a photo and a GPS location.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-2
ATT-02
Arrival Status
Each clock in gets an Arrival Status of OnTime or Late; start 08:00, grace 15 minutes, the same for all.
Acceptance criteria
  • A clock in at 08:15 shows OnTime; at 08:16 shows Late.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-2
ATT-03
Overtime request and approval
An Employee requests Overtime (hours after 17:00 on weekdays or on Sunday) with Date, From Time, To Time and Remarks; the Sales Supervisor approves or rejects it; Status is Pending, Approved or Rejected.
Acceptance criteria
  • A new request has Status Pending.
  • The Sales Supervisor sets it Approved or Rejected.
  • A request not acted on in 48 hours goes to the Area Sales Manager.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-2OI-27
ATT-04
Attendance and Overtime reports
Sales Supervisor and above see an Attedance Sheet/Report and an Overtime sheet/report, filtered by date, area, supervisor and agent, with Excel export.
Acceptance criteria
  • The sheet lists each Employee's clock in/out for a chosen date.
  • The Overtime report lists Overtime with its Status.
  • The sheets export to Excel.
ShouldNeomeRFP-1, WS-2
ATT-05
Missed Clock-out
An Employee with no clock out by 23:59 is clocked out by the app and marked Missed Clock-out; the Sales Supervisor fixes the time.
Acceptance criteria
  • At 23:59 an open Attendance gets Clock Out 23:59 and the mark Missed Clock-out.
  • The Sales Supervisor can change the Clock Out time.
MustNeomeWS-2OI-28
ATT-06
Attendance offline
An Employee clocks in and out with no network; records sync when online.
Acceptance criteria
  • With the phone offline, clock in saves and shows after sync.
MustNeomeWS-2

No Requirements match.

Module · LEAVE

Leave Management

Employees apply for Casual or Sick Leave with automatic balance checks; the Sales Supervisor approves.

Neome App

Attendance & Leave

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Leave with Leave For, Type Of Leave, dates, Status → Leave request; Leave Balance → Leave type with quota and Leave balance, set up with the Owner's yearly quota, Casual carry forward of 5 and Unpaid Days beyond balance; routing to the Sales Supervisor with 48-hour escalation to the Area Sales Manager → line manager approval from Employee Directory with platform escalation; Holiday List added as an extra record so Sundays and holidays are not counted; Leave register is not one of the App's named reports, so set up as a report with filters and Excel export; push on decision as platform mechanics

Status flow
LEAVE-01
Apply for leave
An Employee applies for Casual or Sick Leave, Full Day or Half Day, with From Date, To Date and reason, seeing the balance automatically; Half Day takes 0.5 day and Sundays and public holidays are not counted.
Acceptance criteria
  • The form shows the Employee's current balance for the chosen leave type.
  • A Half Day request takes 0.5 day.
  • A request from Friday to Monday counts Friday and Monday only (Sunday not counted).
  • A request for more days than the balance can be sent; the extra days are marked Unpaid Leave.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3OI-30 OI-31
LEAVE-02
Balance check
Leave applications are checked against the Employee's leave balance automatically; days beyond the balance become Unpaid Leave.
Acceptance criteria
  • A request for more days than the balance shows the Unpaid Days before it is sent.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3OI-30
LEAVE-03
Supervisor approval
A leave request starts Pending and goes to the Employee's Sales Supervisor, who approves or rejects it; if not acted on in 48 hours it goes to the Area Sales Manager.
Acceptance criteria
  • A pending request shows to the Sales Supervisor; after approval its Status is Approved.
  • A request not acted on in 48 hours goes to the Area Sales Manager.
  • The Employee can cancel own Pending request; a rejected request is not reopened, the Employee adds a new one.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3OI-29
LEAVE-04
Update balance on approval
When leave is approved, the Employee's leave balance is updated.
Acceptance criteria
  • Approving 2 days Casual Leave lowers Casual Leave Balance by 2; rejecting changes nothing.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3OI-22
LEAVE-05
Leave balance set-up
The Owner sets the yearly leave balances: Casual 12 days and Sick 10 days, credited 1 January; Casual carries forward max 5 days, Sick none.
Acceptance criteria
  • On 1 January each Employee gets 12 Casual and 10 Sick days.
  • An unused Casual balance of 8 carries forward as 5; unused Sick carries forward as 0.
MustNeomeWS-3OI-22
LEAVE-06
Holiday list
The Owner keeps a yearly list of Zambian public holidays; Sundays and listed holidays are not counted in leave.
Acceptance criteria
  • A public holiday on the list inside a leave request is not counted.
MustNeomeWS-3OI-31
LEAVE-07
Leave register
Sales Supervisor and above see a Leave register, filtered by date, area, supervisor and agent, with Excel export.
Acceptance criteria

Voice entry in English and Nyanja filling the Visit Book order and Complaint form, and Planogram suggestion from a Modern Trade shelf photo → no App page models either; built by Neomenta on the platform; Ask Neome → platform Conversational AI and Contextual Search & Answers over the data the user may see, set up as Configuration; the catalog does not say voice, Nyanja or image analysis are supported (catalog section 5 item 15)

Module · SAP

SAP Integration

Keep neome and SAP in step for customers, products, employees, prices, stock and invoices, through a plugin the Neome team writes.

Neome App

FMCG Field Sales & Distribution

Delivery · indicative
Custom
How

Customers, products, employees, price lists, credit limits and open balances → Outlet, Warehouse/depot stock and Customer ledger of the field sales App, filled from SAP; plugin built by the Neome team on the SAP Business One Service Layer; Sync setting, Sync record (Sync status Waiting to sync / Synced / Failed) and Sync log added as a new record type; dashboard set-up for frequency; ERP links are never Standard and the App page names no ERP/DMS integration (catalog 4b rule 5, section 5 gap 6); Scope tag Neome as the Neome team builds the plugin. Rests on OI-08, OI-11 (closed)

Status flow
SAP-01
Customer sync
Customers created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; customers created or changed in neome go to SAP after the Sales Supervisor approves the Change Request; on a clash SAP wins.
Acceptance criteria
  • A customer added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
  • A new customer made in neome is not in SAP until the Sales Supervisor approves it, then it is.
  • A customer changed in both places shows the SAP value in neome.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-14OI-10 OI-13 OI-65
SAP-02
Product sync
Products created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; products made or changed in neome by the Owner are pushed to SAP direct; on a clash SAP wins.
Acceptance criteria
  • A product added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
  • A product added in neome by the Owner is in SAP after the push.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-14OI-10 OI-65
SAP-03
Employee sync
Employees created or changed in SAP are fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; employees made or changed in neome by the Owner are pushed to SAP direct; on a clash SAP wins.
Acceptance criteria
  • An employee added in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
  • An employee added in neome by the Owner is in SAP after the push.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-14OI-10 OI-65
SAP-04
Stock sync from SAP
Warehouse stock changed in SAP is fetched by the plugin and shown in neome every 30 minutes; neome never writes stock to SAP.
Acceptance criteria
  • A stock change in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.
  • A stock change or closing stock made in neome is not sent to SAP.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-14OI-09 OI-48
SAP-05
Invoice to SAP
An invoice made in neome for a new order is sent by the plugin to SAP at once and is visible in SAP; a failed push is retried and shows Waiting to sync.
Acceptance criteria
  • The invoice of an order placed in neome is visible in SAP within minutes.
  • With SAP down the invoice shows Waiting to sync and goes when SAP is back.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-14OI-11 OI-38
SAP-06
Plugin set up from neome dashboard
The Owner sets the plugin in the neome dashboard: SAP connection and sync frequency per data type.
Acceptance criteria
  • The Owner changes the product sync frequency in the dashboard and the next sync follows it.
  • Only the Owner can change these settings.
MustNeomeRFP-1, IN-1, WS-14OI-11

Neome builds the plugin
The Neome team writes the plugin for SAP Business One 10.0 (HANA) over the Service Layer REST API, with credentials from the SAP partner.

SAP-08
Prices, credit limits and open balances from SAP
The price list per Customer Category, the credit limit and the open balance of each customer are fetched from SAP with the customer and product sync, every 30 minutes.

  • A price changed in SAP shows in neome within 30 minutes.

Sync status and failed records
Each synced record carries a Sync status: Waiting to sync, Synced or Failed; a record SAP rejects shows Failed with the SAP message to the Owner and is retried each cycle.
Acceptance criteria
  • A record SAP rejects shows Failed with the SAP message in the Owner's dashboard.
  • A Failed record that SAP accepts on a later cycle becomes Synced.

Customer Code from SAP

Sync log

Across all Modules

Engagement-wide Requirements

Requirements no single Module owns, grouped by topic. They are not mapped to a Neome App and are not in the fit table.

Access · users, roles and permissions

GEN-01
Role-based access control
Each user type gets role-based access for their scope. Area Sales Managers see their own area; Regional Sales Managers see their own region and approve leave escalations; Sales Head and Owner see all. The Owner alone has settings.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Sales Supervisor can approve a leave escalation.
  • A Quality Manager can view all Complaints and change their status, with no other access.
  • "Supervisor" means Sales Supervisor; "Admin" means Owner. Sales Agents, Tricycle Riders and Sales Supervisors are Employees.
  • An Area Sales Manager sees only their own area's modules and has no settings or user admin.
  • A Regional Sales Manager sees only their own region and has no settings.
  • A Sales Head sees all data and reports and can set targets, with no settings.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1
GEN-02
Owner full access proposed, to confirm
The Owner has full access to all modules, analytics and settings.
Acceptance criteria
  • The Owner can open every module, report and setting.
TBCOpenRFP-1
GEN-03
Area Sales Manager full access
The Area Sales Manager has access to all modules in their own area, without settings or user admin. The Owner alone has settings.
Acceptance criteria
  • The Area Sales Manager can open each module for their own area only.
  • The Area Sales Manager cannot open settings or manage users.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1

Glossary

260 Brands terms used in this document

TermMeaning at 260 BrandsSources
Ownerproposed, to confirmUser with full access to all modules, analytics and settings; adds masters.RFP-1
Sales Supervisorproposed, to confirmAssigns beats and products to field staff, manages orders, monitors performance.RFP-1
Employeeproposed, to confirmStaff member who clocks in/out, applies for leave and manages assigned inventory.RFP-1
Sales Agentproposed, to confirmField staff who places orders, collects payments, generates leads, logs visits and complaints.RFP-1
Tricycle Riderproposed, to confirmField staff who records marketing visits only.RFP-1
Area Sales Managerproposed, to confirmManager with full access to all modules.RFP-1
Regional Sales Managerproposed, to confirmSales manager role; access not yet defined.RFP-1
Sales Headproposed, to confirmSales head role; access not yet defined.RFP-1
Routeproposed, to confirmA sales route; each Beat sits on one Route.RFP-1
Beatproposed, to confirmA sales area on a Route; customers and employees are assigned to Beats for orders and visits.RFP-1, IN-1
Employee - Beat Mappingproposed, to confirmThe Beats a Sales Supervisor has assigned to an employee.RFP-1
Customer GEO Taggingproposed, to confirmRecording a customer's map location in the app.RFP-1, IN-1
Customer Codeproposed, to confirmA customer's code in the Customer Master.RFP-1
TPINproposed, to confirmA customer's TPIN number in the Customer Master.RFP-1
Case Sizeproposed, to confirmA product's case size, kept in the Product Master and Competitor Master.RFP-1
Sales Agent Inventoryproposed, to confirmProducts a Sales Supervisor has assigned to a Sales Agent to sell from; orders reduce it.
Avoid: Assign Inventory, Stock Assignment
RFP-1, WS-4
Stock Returnproposed, to confirmUnsold stock a Sales Agent returns at end of day; the Sales Supervisor counts it at the depot and accepts it (Pending, Accepted).RFP-1, WS-4
Visit Bookproposed, to confirmRecord of a customer visit by sales or marketing staff, with an optional order and payment.
Avoid: Daily Visits
RFP-1
Marketing Visitproposed, to confirmA visit recorded by a Tricycle Rider (or Sales Agent) for sampling and brand awareness, with Visit type and customer details.RFP-1, WS-7
School Visitproposed, to confirmA visit to a school, recording its procurement officer, head teacher and number of children.RFP-1
Farm Visitproposed, to confirmA visit to a farm, recording the person met and family size.RFP-1
Door to door Visitproposed, to confirmA household visit, recording the person met and family size.
Avoid: D2D
RFP-1
Visit typeproposed, to confirmThe kind of Marketing Visit: School, Farm, Door to door or Shop activation.WS-7
D2D - Nurtamilkproposed, to confirmA door to door campaign for the Nurtamilk brand.RFP-1, WS-7
Modern Tradeproposed, to confirmDaily update for a modern trade Store: shelf photos, stock count, competitor activities, supervisor review.RFP-1, WS-8
Storeproposed, to confirmA modern trade store; also a Customer (Category Supermarket) flagged "Modern Trade".RFP-1, WS-8
Closing Stock Inventoryproposed, to confirmStock per product per Store from Modern Trade stock counts.
Avoid: Closing stock
RFP-1, WS-8
Competitorproposed, to confirmA competing brand and its products, kept in the Competitor Master by the Sales Supervisor.RFP-1, WS-8
Customer Complaintproposed, to confirmA customer's product quality complaint logged by an agent for resolution tracking.
Avoid: Complain Ticket, Customer Quality Complaint
RFP-1, WS-9
Change Requestproposed, to confirmA Sales Agent's request to change customer details (address, phone, GEO) or add a new Customer; the Sales Supervisor approves; then it is pushed to SAP.WS-6
Leadproposed, to confirmA possible new customer generated by a Sales Agent. Status: New, Contacted, Interested, Converted, Lost.RFP-1, WS-6
Productive callproposed, to confirmA visit with an order. A visit with no order is non-productive.RFP-1, WS-11
Notice Boardproposed, to confirmIn-app board for notices.RFP-1, WS-12
Weekly Beat Planproposed, to confirmWhich Beat an employee works on each weekday, Monday to Saturday, made by the Sales Supervisor.WS-1
Arrival Statusproposed, to confirmMarks a clock in as OnTime or Late. Start 08:00, grace 15 min; after 08:15 is Late.RFP-1, WS-2
Overtimeproposed, to confirmHours worked after 17:00 on weekdays or on Sunday. The Employee requests it; the Sales Supervisor approves.WS-2
Missed Clock-outproposed, to confirmMark on a day the Employee did not clock out; the app clocks out at 23:59 and the Sales Supervisor fixes the time.WS-2
Leave Balanceproposed, to confirmDays of Casual Leave or Sick Leave an Employee has left in the year. Casual 12 and Sick 10 days credited 1 January; Casual carries forward max 5.RFP-1, WS-3
Unpaid Leaveproposed, to confirmLeave days beyond the Leave Balance; allowed.WS-3
Holiday Listproposed, to confirmYearly list of Zambian public holidays kept by the Owner; not counted in leave.WS-3
Depot Stockproposed, to confirmWarehouse stock per product at the depot, read from SAP every 30 minutes; no warehouse transactions are kept in the app.WS-4
Stock in handproposed, to confirmReport of what each Sales Agent holds per product: assigned, sold, returned, in hand.WS-4
Van saleproposed, to confirmAn order the Sales Agent delivers from the van at once: Placed, Invoiced and Delivered in the same visit.WS-5
No-order reasonproposed, to confirmReason a Sales Agent picks for a visit with no order: Shop closed, Stock enough, No money, Owner not there, Other.WS-5
Invoiceproposed, to confirmMade in the app for an order, numbered INV-<agent code>-<seq>, VAT 16% shown; PDF sent on WhatsApp, printable on a Bluetooth printer; pushed to SAP.WS-5
Mobile Moneyproposed, to confirmPayment mode through Airtel or MTN.WS-5
Quality Managerproposed, to confirmQuality team member who resolves customer complaints: investigates, fills Operator and Shift, writes the resolution note, sets the statuses.WS-9
Feedbackproposed, to confirmCustomer opinion recorded by a Sales Agent as a rating from 1 to 5 and an optional comment for each question in the Owner's fixed question list.RFP-1, WS-10
Targetproposed, to confirmMonthly goal the Sales Head sets per Sales Agent, by value (ZMW) and by quantity per product group.RFP-1, WS-11
Incentiveproposed, to confirmMonthly pay-out worked out in a report: 2% of sales value if target 100% or more achieved, 1% if 80 to 99%, none below 80%. Paid through payroll, not in the app.RFP-1, WS-11
Sales valueproposed, to confirmInvoiced and Delivered orders of a Sales Agent in the month, before VAT; Cancelled not counted.WS-11
Areaproposed, to confirmA market: a group of customers and staff. The Sales Head sends notices and promos to all staff of an Area.
Avoid: Market
WS-12
Noticeproposed, to confirmA message the Owner or Sales Head posts on the Notice Board to All staff, an Area or a role; the poster can edit or remove it.RFP-1, WS-12
Ask Neomeproposed, to confirmRead-only questions about sales, visits and attendance that the Owner, Sales Head, Area Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager ask and get answered from the data they may see.RFP-1, WS-13
NLP form fillingproposed, to confirmVoice in English or Nyanja fills the Visit Book order or the Complaint form; the user checks and saves.RFP-1, WS-13
Planogram suggestionproposed, to confirmFrom a Modern Trade shelf photo, a suggested shelf share and missing products; the Sales Supervisor uses it.RFP-1, WS-8, WS-13

ModuleWhat it coversHow Neome delivers itNeome AppDelivery
MSTMastersKeep the base lists (employees, customers, products, beats, routes, stores, categories, competitors) that orders, visits, inventory and reports use.Customer → Outlet, Beat and Route → Beat / route, Product → product catalog and price list, Employee → Executive; Store, Category and Competitor added as master lists with set-up fields; Customer GEO tag via GPS tag; vertical App configured to 260 Brands' route to market, Employee Directory as second App for employee data; SAP sync rules are defined in the SAP Integration spec.FMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
BEATBeat PlanningSales Supervisor assigns Beats to employees so they visit and order only from their Beat's customers.Beat → Beat / route; Employee - Beat Mapping and Weekly Beat Plan → daily beat assignment per executive, set up with one-agent-per-Beat check and Active / Inactive Beat status; Sales Agent customer pick limited to mapped Beats, offline sync as platform mechanics; Employee Directory holds the Employee sideFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
ATTAttendanceRecord Employee clock in/out with camera verification, and Overtime.Attendance with Clock In / Clock Out, photo and GPS, Arrival Status → Executive attendance with location verified; the 08:15 Late rule, Missed Clock-out at 23:59, Overtime with Pending / Approved / Rejected, Sales Supervisor approval and 48-hour escalation set up as extra fields, statuses and approval steps; Employee side from Employee Directory; offline sync as platform mechanics; second App attendance-and-leave for the sheetsFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
LEAVELeave ManagementEmployees apply for Casual or Sick Leave with automatic balance checks; the Sales Supervisor approves.Leave with Leave For, Type Of Leave, dates, Status → Leave request; Leave Balance → Leave type with quota and Leave balance, set up with the Owner's yearly quota, Casual carry forward of 5 and Unpaid Days beyond balance; routing to the Sales Supervisor with 48-hour escalation to the Area Sales Manager → line manager approval from Employee Directory with platform escalation; Holiday List added as an extra record so Sundays and holidays are not counted; Leave register is not one of the App's named reports, so set up as a report with filters and Excel export; push on decision as platform mechanicsAttendance & LeaveConfiguration
INVInventorySupervisors assign product inventory to Sales Agents, who sell from it; unsold stock comes back and is counted; depot stock is read from SAP.Sales Agent Inventory → Executive stock (assigned, sold, left) with Sales Supervisor assigning; Assign Inventory with quantity and Total Amount, Stock Return with Pending and Accepted and counted quantity set up as extra fields and statuses; orders and cancels deducting from Executive stock as the App does for sales and returns; Depot stock → Warehouse/depot stock shown read only, fed from SAP by the plugin (SAP-04, not Standard); Stock in hand is not one of the App's named reports, so set up as a report with filters and Excel export; offline capture as platform mechanicsFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
VBVisit BookRecord customer visits by Sales Agents, place orders, take payment and make the invoice that goes to SAP.Visit → Outlet visit with GPS tag; Order and Order Item → Beat order (traditional retail), with Order Status Placed, Invoiced, Delivered, Cancelled, credit rules by Customer Category and items limited to the agent's Executive stock set up as extra fields and rules; Payment → Collection/payment entry with the payment modes and part payment; customer price lists by Customer Category from the one catalog and price list, fed from SAP; Visit, Order and Payment sheets set up as reports with filters and Excel export (not the App's three named reports); offline capture as the App does. Invoice (number INV-<agent code>-<seq>, VAT, PDF on WhatsApp, Bluetooth print) is not in any App, so a Custom module (VB-09); invoice push to SAP is the plugin, an ERP link never Standard (VB-06, SAP-05)FMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
LEADLeadsSales Agents generate Leads for new business and follow them up until they become Customers or are lost.Lead → Lead; shop name, owner name, phone, address, GEO, Category and notes set up as fields; Status New, Contacted, Interested, Converted, Lost → funnel stages with Interested and Lost added; Sales Agent → Executive owning the Lead; Convert raising a Change Request approved by the Sales Supervisor → conversion approval step, with the new Customer going to CRM and to SAP through Masters and SAP Integration; Lead Sheet/Report with converted-per-month count → Lead performance report with filters and Excel export; offline capture as platform mechanicsLead ManagementConfiguration
MKTMarketing VisitsRecord marketing, school, farm and door to door visits by sales or marketing staff, for product sampling and brand awareness.Marketing Visit and Rider visit → Outlet visit and Rider visit/route with GPS tag, Beat and photo; Visit type values (School, Farm, Door to door, Shop activation), the School, Farm and Door to door forms and the typed new-person fields set up as extra fields and forms; existing Customer pick → CRM account link; Marketing Visit Sheet and Marketing Visits report (visits per rider) are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; offline capture as the App doesFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
MTModern TradeDaily modern trade updates per Store: shelf photos, stock count, competitor activities and Sales Supervisor review, giving Closing Stock Inventory.Modern Trade update and Store → Outlet visit with GPS tag, shelf photo and stock check, on a Customer flagged Modern Trade (an Outlet); Check In / Check Out within 200 m as GPS-verified visit; stock count grid (Shelf, Backroom, Expiry, Total Qty), competitor activities (Competitor Master brand and product) and Submitted / Sent back / Approved review set up as extra fields, forms and an approval step (the App says modern trade uses different forms and approvals); Modern Trade Sheet and Closing Stock Inventory are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; offline capture as the App doesFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
CMPCustomer ComplaintsSales Agents register customer product quality complaints; the Quality Manager resolves them and the customer is told.Customer Complaint → Quality complaint (description, batch number, photo, assigned QA team, status Open → closure), logged by the Sales Agent with offline capture as the App does; the four statuses Open / Under Investigation / Resolved / Closed, Operator, Shift, resolution note and customer signature set up as extra fields and statuses for the Quality Manager; 72 hour target and Complaints aging report and Complaint Sheet are not named App reports, set up as reports with filters and Excel export; WhatsApp message to the customer on Resolved through the platform WhatsApp channelFMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
FBFeedbackA Sales Agent records customer feedback as question and response pairs.Feedback and Feedback answer (question, 1 to 5 rating, comment) have no entity in the field sales App; built as a new record type on the App's Outlet visit mechanics with offline capture; the Owner's fixed question list is a new master; Feedback Sheet with average rating per question is set up as a report with filters and Excel export; Configuration or Custom module is torn, higher proposed, OI-83FMCG Field Sales & DistributionCustom
RPTReports and DashboardsReports, daily summaries and dashboards for sales performance, efficiency, targets and incentives.Target → the App's Target entity (monthly, per Sales Agent, with product group quantity added as extra fields); Target vs Achievement and Debt vs Collection → the App's Target achievement and Collections and outstanding reports, with Enterprise filters (date, area, supervisor, agent, beat, product), role scope and Excel export set up; the other reports, Performance and Efficiency dashboards, Incentive rule (2% / 1% / none) and Customer Master Heat Map set up on the platform dashboards, since the App names only three reports; Debt reads SAP open balances through the sync. No new record type, so no Custom module.FMCG Field Sales & DistributionConfiguration
COMCommunicationReach users and customers through WhatsApp, push notifications, Area notices and a Notice Board.Notice and Notice Board → Post in an Announcements Category with access scope (everyone / department / team) set up as All / Area / role, no pre-publication approval, poster edits or removes; Area is added as an audience field; push to the audience and the push events (leave decision, order cancelled, Change Request decision, target set) set up as notifications on the platform; WhatsApp Message → invoice PDF and Resolved message, retry 3 times and Failed status set up on the platform WhatsApp channel; the App is a forum, so the Notice fields and WhatsApp Message record are added fieldsInternal Community ForumConfiguration
AIAI FeaturesAI help: form filling through NLP, AI based planogram suggestions, and Ask Neome.Voice entry in English and Nyanja filling the Visit Book order and Complaint form, and Planogram suggestion from a Modern Trade shelf photo → no App page models either; built by Neomenta on the platform; Ask Neome → platform Conversational AI and Contextual Search & Answers over the data the user may see, set up as Configuration; the catalog does not say voice, Nyanja or image analysis are supported (catalog section 5 item 15)No catalog App (custom)Custom
SAPSAP IntegrationKeep neome and SAP in step for customers, products, employees, prices, stock and invoices, through a plugin the Neome team writes.Customers, products, employees, price lists, credit limits and open balances → Outlet, Warehouse/depot stock and Customer ledger of the field sales App, filled from SAP; plugin built by the Neome team on the SAP Business One Service Layer; Sync setting, Sync record (Sync status Waiting to sync / Synced / Failed) and Sync log added as a new record type; dashboard set-up for frequency; ERP links are never Standard and the App page names no ERP/DMS integration (catalog 4b rule 5, section 5 gap 6); Scope tag Neome as the Neome team builds the plugin. Rests on OI-08, OI-11 (closed)FMCG Field Sales & DistributionCustom

Configuration
How

Customer → Outlet, Beat and Route → Beat / route, Product → product catalog and price list, Employee → Executive; Store, Category and Competitor added as master lists with set-up fields; Customer GEO tag via GPS tag; vertical App configured to 260 Brands' route to market, Employee Directory as second App for employee data; SAP sync rules are defined in the SAP Integration spec.

IDRequirementAcceptance criteriaPriorityScopeSources · OIs
MST-01Employee MasterThe system keeps an Employee Master with contact details, assigned Beats (multi select) and Casual, Sick and Total Leave Balance. Owner adds and edits Employees; they may also come from SAP.
  • Owner adds an employee, picks one or more Beats, and Total Leave Balance shows Casual + Sick.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1
OI-22 OI-75
MST-02Customer MasterThe system keeps a Customer Master with the fields in RFP-1 §5.2, Category and Classification values, conditional TPIN, and Route filled from the chosen Beat. Owner maintains it; Sales Agents may add Customers through a Change Request.
  • Owner adds a customer, picks a Beat, and the Route of that Beat fills in.

Glossary

260 Brands terms used in this document

TermMeaning at 260 BrandsSources
Ownerproposed, to confirmUser with full access to all modules, analytics and settings; adds masters.RFP-1
Sales Supervisorproposed, to confirmAssigns beats and products to field staff, manages orders, monitors performance.RFP-1
Employeeproposed, to confirmStaff member who clocks in/out, applies for leave and manages assigned inventory.RFP-1
Sales Agentproposed, to confirmField staff who places orders, collects payments, generates leads, logs visits and complaints.RFP-1
Tricycle Riderproposed, to confirmField staff who records marketing visits only.RFP-1
Area Sales Managerproposed, to confirmManager with full access to all modules.RFP-1
Regional Sales Managerproposed, to confirmSales manager role; access not yet defined.RFP-1
Sales Headproposed, to confirmSales head role; access not yet defined.RFP-1
Routeproposed, to confirmA sales route; each Beat sits on one Route.RFP-1
Beatproposed, to confirmA sales area on a Route; customers and employees are assigned to Beats for orders and visits.RFP-1, IN-1
Employee - Beat Mappingproposed, to confirmThe Beats a Sales Supervisor has assigned to an employee.RFP-1
Customer GEO Taggingproposed, to confirmRecording a customer's map location in the app.RFP-1, IN-1
Customer Codeproposed, to confirmA customer's code in the Customer Master.RFP-1
TPINproposed, to confirmA customer's TPIN number in the Customer Master.RFP-1
Case Sizeproposed, to confirmA product's case size, kept in the Product Master and Competitor Master.RFP-1
Sales Agent Inventoryproposed, to confirmProducts a Sales Supervisor has assigned to a Sales Agent to sell from; orders reduce it.
Avoid: Assign Inventory, Stock Assignment
RFP-1, WS-4
Stock Returnproposed, to confirmUnsold stock a Sales Agent returns at end of day; the Sales Supervisor counts it at the depot and accepts it (Pending, Accepted).RFP-1, WS-4
Visit Bookproposed, to confirmRecord of a customer visit by sales or marketing staff, with an optional order and payment.
Avoid: Daily Visits
RFP-1
Marketing Visitproposed, to confirmA visit recorded by a Tricycle Rider (or Sales Agent) for sampling and brand awareness, with Visit type and customer details.RFP-1, WS-7
School Visitproposed, to confirmA visit to a school, recording its procurement officer, head teacher and number of children.RFP-1
Farm Visitproposed, to confirmA visit to a farm, recording the person met and family size.RFP-1
Door to door Visitproposed, to confirmA household visit, recording the person met and family size.
Avoid: D2D
RFP-1
Visit typeproposed, to confirmThe kind of Marketing Visit: School, Farm, Door to door or Shop activation.WS-7
D2D - Nurtamilkproposed, to confirmA door to door campaign for the Nurtamilk brand.RFP-1, WS-7
Modern Tradeproposed, to confirmDaily update for a modern trade Store: shelf photos, stock count, competitor activities, supervisor review.RFP-1, WS-8
Storeproposed, to confirmA modern trade store; also a Customer (Category Supermarket) flagged "Modern Trade".RFP-1, WS-8
Closing Stock Inventoryproposed, to confirmStock per product per Store from Modern Trade stock counts.
Avoid: Closing stock
RFP-1, WS-8
Competitorproposed, to confirmA competing brand and its products, kept in the Competitor Master by the Sales Supervisor.RFP-1, WS-8
Customer Complaintproposed, to confirmA customer's product quality complaint logged by an agent for resolution tracking.
Avoid: Complain Ticket, Customer Quality Complaint
RFP-1, WS-9
Change Requestproposed, to confirmA Sales Agent's request to change customer details (address, phone, GEO) or add a new Customer; the Sales Supervisor approves; then it is pushed to SAP.WS-6
Leadproposed, to confirmA possible new customer generated by a Sales Agent. Status: New, Contacted, Interested, Converted, Lost.RFP-1, WS-6
Productive callproposed, to confirmA visit with an order. A visit with no order is non-productive.RFP-1, WS-11
Notice Boardproposed, to confirmIn-app board for notices.RFP-1, WS-12
Weekly Beat Planproposed, to confirmWhich Beat an employee works on each weekday, Monday to Saturday, made by the Sales Supervisor.WS-1
Arrival Statusproposed, to confirmMarks a clock in as OnTime or Late. Start 08:00, grace 15 min; after 08:15 is Late.RFP-1, WS-2
Overtimeproposed, to confirmHours worked after 17:00 on weekdays or on Sunday. The Employee requests it; the Sales Supervisor approves.WS-2
Missed Clock-outproposed, to confirmMark on a day the Employee did not clock out; the app clocks out at 23:59 and the Sales Supervisor fixes the time.WS-2
Leave Balanceproposed, to confirmDays of Casual Leave or Sick Leave an Employee has left in the year. Casual 12 and Sick 10 days credited 1 January; Casual carries forward max 5.RFP-1, WS-3
Unpaid Leaveproposed, to confirmLeave days beyond the Leave Balance; allowed.WS-3
Holiday Listproposed, to confirmYearly list of Zambian public holidays kept by the Owner; not counted in leave.WS-3
Depot Stockproposed, to confirmWarehouse stock per product at the depot, read from SAP every 30 minutes; no warehouse transactions are kept in the app.WS-4
Stock in handproposed, to confirmReport of what each Sales Agent holds per product: assigned, sold, returned, in hand.WS-4
Van saleproposed, to confirmAn order the Sales Agent delivers from the van at once: Placed, Invoiced and Delivered in the same visit.WS-5
No-order reasonproposed, to confirmReason a Sales Agent picks for a visit with no order: Shop closed, Stock enough, No money, Owner not there, Other.WS-5
Invoiceproposed, to confirmMade in the app for an order, numbered INV-<agent code>-<seq>, VAT 16% shown; PDF sent on WhatsApp, printable on a Bluetooth printer; pushed to SAP.WS-5
Mobile Moneyproposed, to confirmPayment mode through Airtel or MTN.WS-5
Quality Managerproposed, to confirmQuality team member who resolves customer complaints: investigates, fills Operator and Shift, writes the resolution note, sets the statuses.WS-9
Feedbackproposed, to confirmCustomer opinion recorded by a Sales Agent as a rating from 1 to 5 and an optional comment for each question in the Owner's fixed question list.RFP-1, WS-10
Targetproposed, to confirmMonthly goal the Sales Head sets per Sales Agent, by value (ZMW) and by quantity per product group.RFP-1, WS-11
Incentiveproposed, to confirmMonthly pay-out worked out in a report: 2% of sales value if target 100% or more achieved, 1% if 80 to 99%, none below 80%. Paid through payroll, not in the app.RFP-1, WS-11
Sales valueproposed, to confirmInvoiced and Delivered orders of a Sales Agent in the month, before VAT; Cancelled not counted.WS-11
Areaproposed, to confirmA market: a group of customers and staff. The Sales Head sends notices and promos to all staff of an Area.
Avoid: Market
WS-12
Noticeproposed, to confirmA message the Owner or Sales Head posts on the Notice Board to All staff, an Area or a role; the poster can edit or remove it.RFP-1, WS-12
Ask Neomeproposed, to confirmRead-only questions about sales, visits and attendance that the Owner, Sales Head, Area Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager ask and get answered from the data they may see.RFP-1, WS-13
NLP form fillingproposed, to confirmVoice in English or Nyanja fills the Visit Book order or the Complaint form; the user checks and saves.RFP-1, WS-13
Planogram suggestionproposed, to confirmFrom a Modern Trade shelf photo, a suggested shelf share and missing products; the Sales Supervisor uses it.RFP-1, WS-8, WS-13
